newsitem.title: INDIA: India's United Breweries 6-mth net plunges.
newsitem.headline: India's United Breweries 6-mth net plunges.

text.p: Note: United Breweries (UB) is among India's leading brewery groups. The company said net sales in the year ended March 31, 1997 totalled 2.62 billion rupees. It gave a 18-month sales comparision figure of 2.98 billion rupees for the period ending March 31, 1996.
UB said it earned a net profit of 1.0 billion rupees in the year ending March 1997 against the 18-month-to-March 1996 figure of 2.73 billion rupees.
The company said a total prohibition policy in the southern state of Andhra Pradesh and introduction of total prohibition in the northern state of Haryana affected the company's performance.
UB said excise policy changes in the western state of Maharashtra led to no sale in the state for over two motnhs, thus affecting its performance.
